skill_name: Prepare the following ingredients for baking cookies.
workflow: To prepare the ingredients for baking cookies you will need: 1 cup of butter, 1 cup of white sugar, 1 cup of brown sugar, 2 eggs, 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, 2½ cups of all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon of baking soda, and 1 teaspoon of salt.  Mix the butter and both sugars until creamy. Add in the eggs and vanilla extract, and mix until well incorporated. In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, and salt.
